podcast.title: Departure from Duran Duran (2001)
podcast.body: Warren Cuccurullo was asked to leave Duran Duran in 2001 because the band received an offer to reunite with their original lineup. Initially, the departure was amicable with a cash settlement, but it briefly became contentious before calming down. "Warren was asked to leave Durand Durand because the group had received an offer to reunite in their original form."

podcast.title: Entry into Adult Entertainment (2001)
podcast.body: Around the time of his departure from Duran Duran in 2001, Warren Cuccurullo entered the adult entertainment industry. He first appeared naked in a game magazine in Brazil, which led to further similar photo shoots. His fan site was rebuilt in July 2001 to feature this adult content, predating platforms like OnlyFans. Even now, some of his videos are reportedly available on Pornhub. "Around the same time, Warren took his own plunge into the world of adult entertainment when he showed up naked in a game magazine in Brazil."

podcast.title: The Rock Rod Sexual Aid (2002)
podcast.body: In 2002, Warren Cuccurullo began selling a sexual aid modeled after himself, named "the rock rod." While he is currently out of the adult business, he still retains a reputation within the industry. "In 2002, he started selling a sexual aid based on himself. It was called the rock rod."

podcast.title: Guitar Virtuosity and Frank Zappa's Praise (Unspecified Year)
podcast.body: Warren Cuccurullo was a member of Frank Zappa's band, and Zappa himself considered him "brilliant" for his ability to play even the most difficult arrangements perfectly. This skill was particularly impressive given the complexity of Zappa's music. He was named-checked four times on Zappa's "Joe's Garage" album, including in the songs "Catholic Girls" and "Cruisin' for Burgers." "Zappa thought he was brilliant because no matter how difficult an arrangement was, Warren could play it perfectly."

podcast.title: Post-Music and Adult Entertainment Activities (Current)
podcast.body: Beyond music and his past in adult entertainment, Warren Cuccurullo has ventured into restaurant ownership and is known for discussing 9/11 conspiracy theories. He has primarily returned to music. "He also got into restaurant ownership and enjoys talking about 9-11 conspiracy theories."

xref.title: Band Decline (1986)
xref.body: By 1986, Missing Persons began to fall apart, coinciding with Warren Cuccurullo's opportunity to join Duran Duran. "But then in 1986, Missing Persons was falling apart."

xref.title: Formation and Early Success (1980s)
xref.body: Missing Persons was formed in 1980 by Warren Cuccurullo, Tony Bozzio (a former Frank Zappa drummer), and Tony's wife, Dale Bozzio, who had also contributed to Zappa's work. The band found success with several new wave hits, becoming a staple on MTV in the early 1980s. Dale Bozzio, the singer, was known for her uninhibited persona, which included performing nude photo shoots for Hustler magazine in both 1979 and 1980. "Missing Persons had several new wavehids that made them an MTV stable for a while in the early 1980s."
